title: Bond - Long Panel
seoTitle: Bond Metal Roof Tiles - High Profile, Easy Installation
description: Upgrade your roof with Bond metal roof tiles in 8 vibrant shades. Ideal for re-roofing and new builds with innovative overlap. Get a free quote now!

sections.text: Bond Architectural/Structural panel (Scandinavian look) line is simple in form yet at the same time combines tradition with modernity. Uniquely, sculpted with beautiful lines, perfect geometry and shape.

sections.html:
‍

Bond is available in Swedish and German steel in a variety of colours. Both steel manufactures have a superior manufacturing process to ensure colour retention for your bond style roof. Furthermore, our installers will interlock your bond panels on top of your existing shingles, providing extra security for a water proof roof system. Therefore, Stellar Metal Roofing can offer a 55-year warranty on installation and metal, making a bond metal roof a good choice for your roof. Why wouldn’t you not want a lifetime roofing solution with no maintenance, replacement or repair costs?

Rudan Roofing systems are produced east of Toronto with Swedish or German metal. Both coil metal manufactures are leaders in high durability metal production. An advantage of a Stellar Metal roof is the metal coils have a thick layer of zinc coating (275g/m2) on both sides of your roofing or cladding. This extra thick zinc coating protects the steel core from corrosion, especially when scratched or cut. The core thickness of the steel is min 0.55 mm- 25 gauge, the thickest in the industry. Metal roofing has become extremely popular due to its naturally attractive appearance and its ability to self repair and avoid corrosion. Our European metal is available in a variety of colours and finishes. Visit our facility to see all of the options available for your metal project.

sections.html:
• The Bond metal roof tiles are manufactured in 8 shades. Premium product that distinguishes itself by its 24 mm high profile.  Due to its characteristics style and durability, this model is suitable for re-roofing as well as new constructions.
  • The innovative joining system is designed for roof tile modules to overlap on both sides, significantly simplifying the installation time resulting in savings with installation costs.
  • Bond profile is made and protected from 2 of the best coatings available. SSAB- Green Coat organic based sustainable coating, or ArcelorMittal – Granite Deep coating

The AG Panel also known as the Rib Panel is a lightweight, exposed fastener roofing system that is most popular for agricultural buildings, storage facilities, and canopies. With ease of installation in mind, the AG Panel system is a straightforward installation with clean look and simplicity in mind.

Rudan Tile, modular steel roof panels is an innovative and unique new metal roofing product. The tiles are made of premium G90 steel, with matt crinkle look color coating with strong resistance to abrasion and corrosion. Attractive & elegant appearance combined with top quality make it top choice with architects, contractors and homeowners alike.
